description.short: Document forensics. Metadata analysis. No permanent document retention.
description.full: Examine an original PDF, Office file or image for construction, typography, layout, metadata and retained editing evidence. Each examination returns source-bound findings, document metadata and a forensic PDF report. No permanent document retention: your files are processed temporarily and automatically deleted; there is no permanent archive of your documents or reports. Source files are deleted after processing, at the latest one hour after upload. Reports stay available for download for up to 24 hours, then they are deleted.
